اقترحتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَحَتَا (iqtaraḥatā) /iq.ta.ra.ħa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اُقْتُرِحَتَا (uqturiḥatā) /uq.tu.ri.ħa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
